pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR 0125 VFX playback control
pr_body:
## Summary

Completes the remaining ADR 0125 first-release VfxPlayer lifecycle and Project Rust deferred-control gap on current main. The change preserves the existing versioned VFX document/compiler, deterministic CPU runtime, renderer integration, and Editor VFX Builder, while adding explicit stopped/playing/paused semantics, deferred start/pause/stop/restart commands, and copied backend-neutral VFX state queries.

## Validation

Run normal Windows affected validation plus the deterministic VFX Builder visual fixture.
